headline: Weathered Expanse and Linn Mercy Rekindle as Callahans Bleeds On
war_summary: The three hours since our last edition have redrawn the map of unrest. Weathered Expanse, flag-silent at the previous filing, has burst back to life — twenty-nine ownership actions in a day, Spirit Watch the busiest post, the latest logged within the hour — while its losses swell past five thousand on each side. Linn Mercy, likewise dormant this afternoon, resumes its churn about Outwich Ranch and Lathair, and Fishermans Row stands as the freshest front, four actions at Oceanwatch inside two hours with flags passing both ways. The Nevish Line grinds on, Tomb Father and Grief Mother busiest, fresh events inside the hour. Callahans Passage still bleeds heaviest of all, some 2,700 Colonial and 1,800 Warden losses in two hours, though its hourly pace has eased and no base there changed hands; the Dead Lands' sudden toll has cooled markedly from its peak. Farranac Coast has lapsed quiet again, while Godcrofts and Palantine Berm lead the day's flag ledger at forty-six and thirty-six actions yet have reported nothing since early afternoon; Marban Hollow, Stlican Shelf and Stonecradle rest longer still. The prize remains the thirty-four victory towns, and neither banner yet claims the war.
